name: Holman Wholesale Parts & Delivery
old_description: At Holman Wholesale Parts and Delivery, we are fully committed to providing the parts you need, when you need them. We are fortunate to have genuine parts and accessories from dozens of car manufacturers. From luxury, high-performance and sport utility to hybrids, commercial and more.
about:
Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, Holman Wholesale Parts & Delivery operates as the wholesale division of the Holman Automotive Group, a multi-generational automotive retailer in the Southeast. The wholesale arm extends the group's dealership infrastructure to the aftermarket, supplying genuine OEM parts and accessories to body shops, collision centers, and repair facilities across North Carolina, South Carolina, and southern Virginia.

The distributor maintains an inventory valued at more than $10 million, covering 22 vehicle brands from luxury and performance lines to hybrids and commercial models. A network of over 30 dealerships feeds the supply chain, while factory-trained and certified parts personnel provide technical support for identification and sourcing. An in-house delivery fleet offers free next-day service throughout the three-state territory.

Customers range from independent body shops and collision repair centers to mechanical repair facilities and fleet maintenance operations that require original-equipment components for diverse vehicle types. The breadth of brand coverage allows shops to consolidate orders across multiple makes through a single source.

The company positions its one-stop shopping model, rapid delivery, and specialized parts expertise as key differentiators for repair businesses aiming to minimize vehicle downtime.
